name: raycast-dev-project-launcher
title: Dev Project Launcher
description: Recursively scans your development directories, maps subfolders to project entities, and lets you jump straight into VS Code, WebStorm, or iTerm.
author: amine2233

commands.name: list-projects
commands.title: Browse Development Projects
commands.subtitle: Dev Project Launcher
commands.description: Recursively scans your configured development directories and lists every detected project with quick-open actions.

commands.name: manage-app-paths
commands.title: Manage App Paths
commands.subtitle: Dev Project Launcher
commands.description: View, add, or edit the executable/app path used to open each project type in VS Code, WebStorm, and iTerm.

preferences.name: developmentPath
preferences.title: Development Root Directory
preferences.description: The root folder that will be scanned recursively for projects. Leave empty to auto-detect ~/Developer, ~/Development, ~/Projects, ~/Code or ~/dev.

preferences.name: customProjectDirectories
preferences.title: Additional Project Directories
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of extra absolute paths to scan alongside the root directory (e.g. ~/Work,~/OpenSource).

preferences.name: scanDepth
preferences.title: Scan Depth
preferences.description: How many directory levels deep to search for projects below each root.

preferences.name: excludeFolderNames
preferences.title: Exclude Folder Names
preferences.description: Comma-separated folder names to skip while scanning.

preferences.name: defaultVSCodePath
preferences.title: Default VS Code Command/Path
preferences.description: Fallback command or absolute path used to open projects in VS Code when a project type has no specific mapping.

preferences.name: defaultWebStormPath
preferences.title: Default WebStorm Command/Path
preferences.description: Fallback command or absolute path used to open projects in WebStorm when a project type has no specific mapping.

preferences.name: defaultITermPath
preferences.title: Default iTerm App Path
preferences.description: Fallback path to the iTerm.app bundle used when a project type has no specific mapping.
